en: Conditioned by a state that is not a root and is not fixed in the wrongness [of view], a state that is a root and is fixed in the wrongness [of view] arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is not a root and is not fixed in the rightness [of view], a state that is a root and is fixed in the rightness [of view] arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is not a root and is not indeterminate, a state that is not a root and is indeterminate arises by way of root condition. Not-root... [and so forth].
Dependent on a state that is neither-fixed (aniyata), a state that is neither-fixed and not-a-root-cause (nahetu) arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated.
There are three [results] under root-condition, three under predominance-condition (*adhipati*), ... pe ... three under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*).
